_comment: The tall towers of the Vale (W9-T). Three watchtowers of four and five storeys spread across the empty quarters, and the broken light tower on the islet in the Mirror Pond (the isle plateau in data/areas/vale.json exists for it). Each one is climbable to its head and carries a beacon there, so they are the landmarks a lost player steers by. Scenery only: no props. Ground was picked against the real heightfield, flat to 1 m across a 9 m footing and well clear of the water, the road and every other site. Rules in tests/test_towers.gd.
